rows.basis: The earnings release says Arista 'exceeded both our AI networking and campus expansion goals' on revenue of $9 billion. The $9 billion is total revenue, not the AI part. The pack's 65% 'Core' share is a product category, not AI, so it is not used. The call's $3.25bn 2026 AI networking goal and the 48% cloud-and-AI-titans mix are not in the pack and are not revenue.

The MD&A says 'the focus on deployment of AI enabled solutions has driven increased demand for networking' and gives no amount. The 65% Core / 18% Cognitive Adjacencies / 17% software split is by product category, not an AI share.
No statement in the pack links FY2023 revenue to AI, and Arista has no AI segment.
No statement in the pack links FY2022 revenue to AI, and Arista has no AI segment.

The thesis sets Arista capex to none because it is small and not AI. Capex was $119.5m, mostly construction-in-process (up from $8.2m to $107.9m), and no statement ties it to AI. The seller-side signal is the AI networking goal Arista says it exceeded.
